props.note: Mushroom, ASHES's best-known black smoker: about 4 m tall, largely unchanged in size since the late 1980s survey (UW Interactive Oceans, oceanobservatories.org RS03ASHS). dimensions_m[0] (base) is an estimate; no footprint is published. material_hint sulfide renders the near-black metal-sulfide body and rusty staining of a black smoker, unlike Lost City's pale carbonate towers. See sources.md.

Inferno vents high-temperature fluid about 10 m from Mushroom (UW/OOI ASHES field description). The 0.00009 degree northward offset is about 10 m; the bearing is a gameplay choice, not a surveyed position. Height 5 m and 3 m base are build estimates. Seabed snapping preserves ground contact.

Hell: a real named ASHES chimney, 'generally less than about 4 m tall' with several narrow discharge orifices (UW Interactive Oceans). No published coordinate or exact height; placed illustratively in the minor-chimney cluster near Mushroom.

Phoenix: a real named ASHES chimney, 'generally less than about 4 m tall' (UW Interactive Oceans). No published coordinate or exact height; placed illustratively in the minor-chimney cluster near Mushroom.

Virgin: a real named ASHES chimney, 'generally less than about 4 m tall' (UW Interactive Oceans). No published coordinate or exact height; placed illustratively in the minor-chimney cluster near Mushroom. (Virgin Mound, a separate sub-metre anhydrite spire mentioned in the same source, is below this engine's minimum practical prop scale and is not modelled separately.)

Game addition: a sulfide mound carrying a group of black-smoker chimneys, tubeworm clumps and bacterial mats, modelled on the way ASHES chimneys cluster on their mounds (UW Interactive Oceans). Layout is invented; stack heights follow the field, where chimneys are generally under about 4-5 m (Mushroom and Inferno are both roughly 4 m).
